title: Fix ActionInterpreter leaking unmasked player names (unknown_display_name), hidden characters, and unfiltered area items

sections.what: Stop static/js/agent-engine.ts from feeding raw Object.keys(state.players) and raw Object.keys(currentArea.items) to ActionInterpreter, which bypasses stranger name masking, character hiding, and lighting/hidden item visibility.
sections.why: While engine/scene_snapshot.py (lines 6, 153-166) and room-context.ts (lines 408-424, 732) mask unmet strangers and hide concealed/unlit items, static/js/agent-engine.ts (lines 1092-1093 and 1175-1176) builds ActionInterpreter context with Object.keys(currentArea?.items || {}) and Object.keys(state.players || {}). As a result, the interpreter receives unmet database names and hidden objects the character cannot perceive.
sections.how:
1. Extract a shared visibility-aware interpreter context builder in static/js/agent-engine.ts used by both director/react (lines 1082-1101) and interpretProseToDraft (lines 1164-1189).
2. Populate thingsVisible from visibility-filtered non-hidden area items respecting dim/pitch_black light rules (matching PromptBuilder in room-context.ts lines 408-424).
3. Populate peopleHere from state.players_in_area excluding hidden characters and masking unmet strangers via PromptBuilder.anonymousName (matching room-context.ts line 732 and engine/scene_snapshot.py).
4. Add JS unit tests asserting hidden items, hidden characters, and unmet real names never enter ActionInterpreter prompts.
sections.verify: 1. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs with interpreter context tests verifying unmet stranger names, hidden NPCs, and hidden/unlit items are filtered/masked identically to room-context.ts.

acceptance.text: ActionInterpreter context peopleHere uses stranger masking (anonymousName / players_in_area unknown_display_name) for unmet characters and omits hidden characters.
ActionInterpreter context thingsVisible applies area lighting and hidden-item visibility filtering consistent with room-context.ts rather than dumping raw Object.keys(currentArea.items).
All ActionInterpreter call sites in static/js/agent-engine.ts share one sanitized room-perception context helper with unit test verification.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Lens / LLM request inspector when ActionInterpreter (two-stage cognition / Director Mode) is active.

Current availability: static/js/agent-engine.ts (lines 1092-1093 and 1175-1176) builds thingsVisible and peopleHere from raw currentArea.items and Object.keys(state.players).

Manual verification steps:
1. Place an unmet stranger, a hidden NPC, and a hidden item (or dark area) in a character's room with ActionInterpreter enabled.
2. Trigger a turn and inspect the ActionInterpreter userPrompt payload.
   - expected: peopleHere lists the unmet stranger's masked display label instead of real name, excludes hidden NPCs, and excludes hidden items from thingsVisible.
